headline: Jio's record IPO opens amid an AI-driven rout in Korean markets, while Telangana and Andhra Pradesh prepare for El Niño and local polls.

stories.title: Telangana Chief Secretary asks for micro-level El Niño contingency plans
stories.summary: Special Chief Secretary Jayesh Ranjan asked officials to prepare local plans to avert drinking water and electricity shortages. He said new borewell permissions in Hyderabad should not be granted for construction or similar purposes.
stories.why_it_matters: Directly affects water and power in your home state, Telangana.

stories.title: Manipur: one killed in Thoubal clashes; Kuki group announces highway shutdown
stories.summary: Clashes between two communities in Thoubal killed at least one person, with houses and vehicles set on fire, prompting prohibitory orders. Separately, a Kuki group announced a shutdown of a key highway after attacks on villages, and the state transferred a Kamjong SP.
stories.why_it_matters: Renewed violence in Manipur is a major national security and governance issue.

stories.title: Telangana plans 14-month foodgrain buffer amid El Niño threat
stories.summary: Telangana has 9.64 lakh MT of rice, with another 18.39 lakh MT expected, taking the estimated total to 28.03 lakh MT, enough for 11.7 months. Minister Uttam Kumar Reddy said wheat flour and other PDS essentials are being considered.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows how Telangana is preparing for possible food-supply stress.

stories.title: Lathi-charge in Kuppam during nomination scrutiny
stories.summary: Police used lathi-charge in Kuppam during nominations scrutiny amid rivalry between TDP and YSRCP groups. Security was stepped up to prevent further confrontations.
stories.why_it_matters: Local-body poll tension in Andhra Pradesh, at Kuppam, a politically prominent constituency.

stories.title: Vijayawada Mayor race: NDA's Vangaveeti Radha Krishna files nomination
stories.summary: 24 candidates have filed for the Mayor's post so far, and 968 candidates have filed papers for ward member posts in the Vijayawada Municipal Corporation.
stories.why_it_matters: Vijayawada civic polls are a key test of AP's political balance.

stories.title: Naveen Patnaik questions Odisha's silence on AP poll notification in Kotia villages
stories.summary: The decades-old dispute involves Odisha and Andhra Pradesh both claiming 21 of the 28 villages in Kotia Gram Panchayat. Patnaik criticised the Odisha government for not responding to AP's poll notification there.
stories.why_it_matters: An inter-state border dispute involving Andhra Pradesh.

stories.title: 27 kg mephedrone seizure exposes clandestine factory in Maharashtra, links to Hyderabad
stories.summary: A 27.2 kg seizure led EAGLE Force to a clandestine lab, exposing a network of chemical suppliers and equipment dealers. Suspected manufacturers have links to Hyderabad.
stories.why_it_matters: Has a Hyderabad connection in a major drug bust.

stories.title: MeitY asks Meta to review content recommendation algorithms
stories.summary: The Centre has asked Meta, which operates Instagram and Facebook, to review its recommendation algorithms to prevent disproportionate exposure to certain content.
stories.why_it_matters: A regulatory signal on platform algorithms in India.

stories.title: Revanth Reddy sets November-end deadline for Global Summit preparations
stories.summary: The CM inspected construction of the Young India Skills University and told officials to finish at least 15 days ahead of the stipulated deadline.
stories.why_it_matters: Telangana's flagship skilling and investment push.

stories.title: Jaishankar hosts UAE Foreign Minister Al Nahyan in Mumbai
stories.summary: Al Nahyan is to hold wide-ranging talks with External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar on October 20.
stories.why_it_matters: UAE is a key partner for trade, energy and the Indian diaspora.

stories.title: Curfews in Paris and other French cities after rioting
stories.summary: Curfews were imposed in parts of central Paris and other cities after weekend riots. The interior minister admitted police "lost control" in some cities.
stories.why_it_matters: Serious unrest in a major European economy.

stories.title: Zelensky adviser says US intelligence restrictions are costing Ukrainian lives
stories.summary: Adviser Serhii Beskrestnov says there has not been enough time to warn people about incoming missile attacks. The White House said there had been no changes to intelligence sharing.
stories.why_it_matters: Contested claim about US support in the Ukraine war.

stories.title: Albania: seventh day of violent clashes between protesters and police
stories.summary: Almost 300 people have been injured, more than half of them police, in anti-government demonstrations that show no sign of easing.
stories.why_it_matters: Escalating political crisis in Europe.

stories.title: Houthi missile strike on Yemen camp kills 50 recruits
stories.summary: Three missiles hit a camp in government-controlled Shabwa province, which officials say was a training centre for new recruits.
stories.why_it_matters: A major escalation in Yemen's conflict.

stories.title: Israel's election set for October 27
stories.summary: Israelis vote on October 27 in the sixth election since 2019. Al Jazeera explains the system and who gets left out.
stories.why_it_matters: A key election for Middle East geopolitics.

stories.title: Four dead in torrential rain in eastern Spain
stories.summary: Cars were swept away and roads submerged, with residents isolated in parts of Spain's Mediterranean coast.
stories.why_it_matters: Extreme-weather disaster in Europe.

stories.title: Kenyan cult leader Paul Mackenzie guilty of 191 murders
stories.summary: The self-proclaimed pastor, who told parents to starve children, was found guilty on 191 murder charges, all but one of them children.
stories.why_it_matters: Verdict in one of the worst cult killings on record.

stories.title: Japan launches Phobos sample-return mission
stories.summary: Japan launched a five-year uncrewed mission to collect samples from Mars' moon Phobos and bring back about 10g of dust.
stories.why_it_matters: A major space science milestone.

stories.title: KOSPI falls another 5% as AI rout deepens
stories.summary: SK Hynix and Samsung have fallen 35% and 22% from peaks, and Elice plunged as much as 32% on its Seoul debut. Kospi's 2026 gains have shrunk to about 31% from nearly 116% at its June record.
stories.why_it_matters: A sharp AI-chip selloff may spill over to global markets and tech sentiment.

stories.title: Nifty may see relief rally to 23,800–24,200, but FPIs wait for US yields and dollar to peak
stories.summary: Rahul Ghose expects Nifty to end the year lower, with oversold conditions possibly fuelling a relief rally. High oil prices may limit broader gains.
stories.why_it_matters: Context on FPI flows and market direction for a long-term index investor.

stories.title: IT and FMCG lose their defensive sheen
stories.summary: Slowing growth, disruption and changing investor expectations mean the traditional safe-haven sectors are no longer cushioning volatility.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to the sector mix inside your index funds.

stories.title: Supreme Court upholds quashing of Yes Bank's ₹8,415 crore AT-1 write-off
stories.summary: The Supreme Court upheld the Bombay High Court's decision to quash Yes Bank's 2020 write-off of AT-1 bonds.
stories.why_it_matters: A major precedent for bank-bond investors.

stories.title: Fresh inflows into gold FoFs halted
stories.summary: Restricting FoF inflows serves to limit foreign exchange leakage.
stories.why_it_matters: Affects gold allocation routes for mutual-fund investors.

stories.title: 1 Finance gets in-principle SEBI approval for MF Lite
stories.summary: It plans to launch passive mutual funds in Q4 FY27 under SEBI's eased framework for eligible passive fund houses.
stories.why_it_matters: More competition in index funds and ETFs could lower costs.

stories.title: EPFO explains steps to claim full ₹15,000 under PM-VBRY
stories.summary: Eligible first-time EPFO-registered employees earning up to ₹1 lakh monthly may get up to ₹15,000, with the first installment after six months of service.
stories.why_it_matters: A PF-linked employment incentive scheme.

stories.title: Markets closed for Dussehra
stories.summary: Of 16 stock market holidays in 2026, twelve have passed; three more remain after Dussehra.
stories.why_it_matters: Trading calendar.

stories.title: Jio Platforms IPO opens October 21: ₹30,213 crore, India's largest ever
stories.summary: The price band is ₹1,065-1,119 per share and the issue closes October 23. It is an entirely fresh issue of 27 crore shares, surpassing Hyundai Motor India's 2024 record.
stories.why_it_matters: The biggest IPO in Indian history opens this week.

stories.title: Jio Platforms raises ₹8,110 crore from anchor investors
stories.summary: Jio Platforms raised ₹8,109.8 crore from anchor investors ahead of opening its public issue.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows institutional demand before the issue opens.

stories.title: Tonbo Imaging IPO subscribed about 140x
stories.summary: The ₹852 crore issue drew bids for 1,15,86,91,464 shares against 85,26,033 on offer. QIBs subscribed 293.56x, NIIs 170.94x and retail 31.06x.
stories.why_it_matters: A very strong close for a defence-tech IPO.

stories.title: Paras Healthcare raises ₹652 crore from anchors; IPO opens Oct 21
stories.summary: It allotted 94,15,584 shares to 39 funds at ₹693 apiece, totalling ₹652.5 crore.
stories.why_it_matters: Another IPO opening this week.

stories.title: Zetwerk's ₹5,012 crore IPO subscribed 3.06x
stories.summary: The issue was subscribed 3.06 times on Monday, the last day for bids.
stories.why_it_matters: A modest subscription compared with Tonbo.

stories.title: Nscale and Anthropic reportedly in talks for $45B compute deal
stories.summary: If done, it would be the latest in a long string of giant compute deals Anthropic has struck over the past year.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows the scale of compute spending driving the AI industry.

stories.title: CoreWeave's debt becoming the AI industry's problem
stories.summary: CoreWeave's bonds slipped into distressed territory, with investors demanding over 1,000 basis points more than government bonds. This prompted questions about whether the AI buildout is a private credit bubble.
stories.why_it_matters: Fits with the AI-linked selloff in Asia and any hiring slowdown it may cause.

stories.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, stealing API keys
stories.summary: Hackers got into part of the open-source agent's platform and stole some users' API keys, running up charges on their AI accounts.
stories.why_it_matters: A security risk for anyone using coding agents.

stories.title: Hacker breaks into 100+ sites using an army of AI agents
stories.summary: AI security firm Norforge found the agents mostly operated on their own; Reuters reports victims included John Deere, SharkNinja and Cummins.
stories.why_it_matters: Shows agentic attacks are now real.

stories.title: Microsoft likens AI agents to insider threats
stories.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents employees use with systems not controlled by labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.
stories.why_it_matters: Enterprise agent governance is a core theme for FDE work.

stories.title: Nvidia launches open models for enterprise and PC agents
stories.summary: Nvidia is leaning into enterprises wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers, plus on-device private agents.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals demand for self-hosted agents.

stories.title: Amazon launches TorchNeuron to challenge Nvidia on PyTorch
stories.summary: Amazon wants more developers to run PyTorch apps on alternative chips such as its own.
stories.why_it_matters: Could shift AI infrastructure tooling.

stories.title: Goodfire researcher's claim on neural networks stirs AI world
stories.summary: Nick Cammarata's 26,000-word blog post claims good news about the nature of neural networks, prompting speculation and celebration.
stories.why_it_matters: A possible interpretability breakthrough being debated.

stories.title: MiniMax M3.1 Flash released
stories.summary: MiniMax published M3.1 Flash, which drew 428 points on Hacker News.
stories.why_it_matters: Another model option to track.

stories.title: Cloudflare cut its AI code-review inference bill by 68%
stories.summary: After per-run cost doubled, Cloudflare used prompt caching and intelligent model routing to cut the bill while speeding up reviews.
stories.why_it_matters: Practical lessons on LLM cost optimisation for production.

stories.title: JDK 28 finalizes structured concurrency via JEP 543
stories.summary: It ends seven preview rounds with no API changes from JDK 27. Code written for JDK 25 or 26 must adapt to the changes noted.
stories.why_it_matters: Relevant to Java backend work.

stories.title: Pinterest uses event-time watermarks to finalize petabyte-scale partitions
stories.summary: Pinterest uses Flink to track event time and Iceberg metadata to publish a non-regressing watermark for CDC ingestion.
stories.why_it_matters: A good write-up on streaming data completeness.

stories.title: From microservices to agents: the next evolution of distributed systems
stories.summary: The article contrasts functional decomposition with decision decomposition, and discusses new complexity in observability and reliability.
stories.why_it_matters: Links distributed systems skills to agent architecture.

stories.title: Ask HN: shipping AI-written code you don't understand
stories.summary: A thread prompted by a Meta engineer's LinkedIn post about code feeling like a black box as AI shipping speeds up.
stories.why_it_matters: A live debate over engineering practice.

stories.title: Plex media server attacks chain 4 vulnerabilities
stories.summary: A researcher says attackers are hacking unpatched boxes, so patching is urged.
stories.why_it_matters: Actionable security alert.

stories.title: Urban Company falls 9.5% after Q2 loss widens; board clears ₹2,500 crore fundraise
stories.summary: Shares ended 9.92% lower at ₹142.6 on the BSE.
stories.why_it_matters: A read on Indian consumer-tech profitability.

stories.title: ixigo jumps after Q2 profit swings to ₹63 crore
stories.summary: Shares ended 8.8% higher at ₹157.05 on the BSE.
stories.why_it_matters: A profitable Indian tech listing.

stories.title: Hunar raises ₹40 crore for agentic AI in frontline hiring
stories.summary: The startup is building agentic AI for coordination-heavy frontline hiring.
stories.why_it_matters: Agentic AI applied to hiring.

stories.title: FSSAI issues show-cause notices to Zepto and others
stories.summary: The FSSAI crackdown continues with fresh notices to quick-commerce unicorn Zepto.
stories.why_it_matters: Regulatory risk for Indian startups.

stories.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation
stories.summary: The Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to stay independent after acquisition interest.
stories.why_it_matters: Signals funding in AI chips.

stories.title: Ramesh Powar appointed men's national selector; Ojha to chair
stories.summary: Powar, who played two Tests and 31 ODIs, fills the vacancy left after Ajit Agarkar's term ended.
stories.why_it_matters: Selection panel change shapes the Indian team.

stories.title: Chinmay Sutar scores 400* for Mizoram in Ranji Trophy
stories.summary: He became the second Indian batter to hit a quadruple century after Bhausaheb Nimbalkar in 1948.
stories.why_it_matters: A rare domestic cricket record.

stories.title: Afghanistan beat Zimbabwe comprehensively
stories.summary: Atal scored 102 and Rashid took 4 for 17 as Zimbabwe were bowled out for 136 chasing 295.
stories.why_it_matters: Decisive result in the ongoing tournament.

stories.title: WPL 2027 mini auction on October 28 in Kochi
stories.summary: 146 players will compete for 27 slots, with Molineux and Dunkley at the top base price of INR 50 lakh.
stories.why_it_matters: Upcoming women's league auction.
